scope: LLM-judged comparative evaluation of a text-based schizophrenia speech prompt module; expert validation deferred.
status: Measurement definitions fixed before new comparison outputs; no new generation or paid API authorized by this file.

severity_scale.2: Repeated and interfering with following the answer

scale_status: Research operational scale informed by TLC concepts, not a validated clinical TLC score. Classify across the interview, not by fixed occurrence counts from a 45-minute examination.
targets: Before generation, assign each primary feature 0..3 or null=unspecified. Positive targets contribute to target realization; explicit zero targets contribute to unwanted expression. Unspecified features contribute to neither.

judge_stage_1.input: Opaque item ID, complete interviewer-patient transcript, fixed feature rubric
judge_stage_1.output: Observed severity 0..3 or null=uncertain/unassessable; exact transcript evidence and concise reason for every feature
judge_stage_1.self_description: Saying that one's thoughts are disorganized is not evidence that the speech itself is disorganized. Clinical terminology must not substitute for observed form.

judge_stage_2.input: Opaque ID, transcript, fixed case facts and predeclared applicable fact/interaction checks; no condition or generating prompt
judge_stage_2.note: Only required/elicited facts enter the preservation denominator. Reserved disclosure or intended speech poverty must be represented in case-specific requirements, not penalized as failure by a blanket completeness rule.

metrics.definition: Among positive primary-feature targets, proportion judged present (observed severity >=1). Report per feature and equal-feature macro mean. Unknown judgments give lower/upper bounds, not zero imputation.
Among explicit zero primary-feature targets, proportion judged present. Report per feature and equal-feature macro mean; retain unknown-value bounds.

Correct predeclared applicable factual checks / all applicable factual checks. Omitted and contradicted are failures; uncertainty is bounded. Report contradiction rate and applicability coverage separately.

Passed predeclared applicable interaction checks / all applicable checks. Report uncertain-value bounds and each check separately. A generic requirement for coherent/relevant speech must not punish intended derailment or incoherence.

Absolute observed-target difference on 0..3 for positive targets. Report mean known error, known fraction and full-denominator bounds for unknown observations. This is engineering ordinal-level error, not clinical severity accuracy.

aggregation: Checks are first averaged within each case and feature/check type, then cases receive equal weight, then primary features receive equal weight. Repeated generations and turns are not independent patients. Report all cell counts and missing/applicability fractions. Do not reweight feature coverage differently across conditions.
comparisons: Same generator/version/reasoning effort/settings, supplied clinical facts, target phenotype, interviewer questions and repetition plan. Main contrast: strong existing structured persona adapted to schizophrenia versus proposed module. Simple roleplay is a secondary baseline.
judge_lock: Fix actual evaluator identifier/version, rubric hash, inference settings if available, context policy and primary run before scoring. Qwen is not automatically the evaluator. A different model family from the generator is preferred but does not establish statistical independence or clinical validity.
judge_repeat: Repeat scoring on a prespecified 25% subset chosen before outputs. Keep the first fixed run as primary; report repeat disagreement rather than selecting the preferred score. If only limited controls are available, state that evaluator accuracy remains unvalidated.
missingness: Missing, failed, or truncated generations retain their planned denominator and produce unknown observation slots. Report technical completion separately. Missing entire case-condition records must fail dataset validation, not disappear from summaries.
improvement_claim: No weighted schizophrenia total score. Evaluate primary case-matched gains with uncertainty and inspect all guardrail tradeoffs. A higher target-realization rate alone is insufficient for an unqualified improvement claim. A clinical resemblance or data-augmentation claim needs later external validation.
